baseline: Prior three completed seasons; offense/defense arithmetic mean; eight-game league shrinkage; empirical home-field margin split equally.
challenger: Same score formula, but include completed earlier weeks of the target season; exponentially weight each team's appearances with a fixed 16-game half-life and eight-game league shrinkage.
information_cutoff: Exclude all target-week games and all later weeks; use final regular-season scores only.
comparison: Paired errors on identical games; bootstrap whole weeks with a fixed seed, 2000 resamples.
research_gate: Total MAE improvement interval must be strictly below zero; no secondary error metric may worsen by over 2 percent. Passing is eligibility for prospective testing, not promotion.
limitations: Historical source differs from original ESPN priors: this reproduces the baseline method, not its exact stored historical predictions.
Retrospective final data lacks original ingestion timestamps.
No injury, pace or player-context coefficients are being validated.
No win-probability calibration or wagering return claim.
